about: SPEC 19.41: who a to-do (tasklist.sh, kinds 2100-2103) is on. claim = the author takes it; unclaim = the assignee lets go (only theirs); assign = anyone in the channel puts it on ["p", <hex>], or on nobody (no p). Latest event wins, in created_at order. Each case: the 2101s after the 2100 (by A at 100), and the expected assignee / assigned_by (null = none). wire: what a client sends for a choice by ME.
generated_by: belfry-ios (hand-written, 2026-11-18; the web's model.ts tasklist() reads claim / unclaim only, assign is new)
keys: A, B, C each stand for 64 times that letter in lower case (a hex key); <task> is the 2100's id; every 2101 also carries ["t", <list id>] and ["h", <group>] after these tags
